::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Slots and daily abilities **save in your browser** — survive page refreshes during a session. Click **Long Rest** to reset everything.
:::

## Spell Slot Tracker

```{=html}
<div class="tracker-panel">
  <h3>⚡ Spell Slots <span style="font-size:.75rem;font-weight:normal;color:#8B6914">(shared pool — Wizard INT &amp; Ranger WIS both draw from here)</span></h3>
  <div id="slot-tracker"></div>
  <div class="tracker-buttons" style="margin-top:.75rem">
    <button class="tracker-btn" onclick="resetLongRest()">🌙 Long Rest — reset all slots</button>
    <button class="tracker-btn secondary" onclick="arcaneRecovery()">🔁 Arcane Recovery (Short Rest)</button>
  </div>
  <p style="font-size:.75rem;color:#5C3A1E;margin:.5rem 0 0">
    <b>Arcane Recovery:</b> once per day on a short rest, recover spell slots with combined level ≤ <b>2</b> (half wizard level, rounded up).<br>
    <b>Ranger spells</b> (Hunter's Mark, Cure Wounds) use the same slots · Hunter's Mark can also be cast <b>2× per day free</b> via Favored Enemy (Hobgoblin).
  </p>
</div>

<div class="tracker-panel">
  <h3>☀️ Daily &amp; Per-Rest Abilities</h3>
  <div class="daily-grid" id="daily-tracker"></div>
  <div class="tracker-buttons" style="margin-top:.5rem">
    <button class="tracker-btn secondary" onclick="resetDaily()">🌅 New Day — reset all daily abilities</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const SLOTS_KEY  = 'tiberius-slots-v1';
const DAILY_KEY  = 'tiberius-daily-v1';
const AR_KEY     = 'tiberius-ar-v1';

// ── Slot configuration ──────────────────────────────────────
const SLOT_CONFIG = [
  { level: '1st', max: 4, label: '1st Level' },
  { level: '2nd', max: 3, label: '2nd Level' },
  { level: '3rd', max: 0, label: '3rd Level (Wizard 5)', future: true },
];

// ── Daily abilities ─────────────────────────────────────────
const DAILY_ABILITIES = [
  { id: 'javelin',    label: 'Javelin of Lightning',   note: '1/dawn · 4d6 ⚡ lightning line, DC 14 DEX' },
  { id: 'ar',         label: 'Arcane Recovery',         note: '1/day short rest · recover up to 2 slot levels' },
  { id: 'magearmor',  label: 'Mage Armor',              note: '8 hr duration · AC 15' },
  { id: 'huntersmark1', label: "Hunter's Mark — use 1",   note: '2× free/day (Favored Enemy: Hobgoblin) · Conc., 1 hr' },
  { id: 'huntersmark2', label: "Hunter's Mark — use 2",   note: '2nd free use · uses a slot if both spent' },
];

// ── State helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────
function loadSlots()  { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SLOTS_KEY)) || {}; } catch { return {}; } }
function saveSlots(s) { localStorage.setItem(SLOTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(s)); }
function loadDaily()  { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(DAILY_KEY)) || {}; } catch { return {}; } }
function saveDaily(d) { localStorage.setItem(DAILY_KEY, JSON.stringify(d)); }

// ── Render slots ────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderSlots() {
  const state = loadSlots();
  const container = document.getElementById('slot-tracker');
  container.innerHTML = '';

  SLOT_CONFIG.forEach(cfg => {
    if (cfg.future && cfg.max === 0) return; // hide empty future slots

    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'slot-row';

    const lbl = document.createElement('div');
    lbl.className = 'slot-row-label';
    lbl.textContent = cfg.label;

    const pips = document.createElement('div');
    pips.className = 'slot-pips';

    if (cfg.future) {
      const note = document.createElement('span');
      note.style.cssText = 'font-size:.75rem;color:#8B6914;font-style:italic';
      note.textContent = '(not yet available)';
      pips.appendChild(note);
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < cfg.max; i++) {
        const pip = document.createElement('div');
        pip.className = 'pip' + (state[cfg.level + '-' + i] ? ' used' : '');
        pip.title = state[cfg.level + '-' + i] ? 'Expended — click to restore' : 'Available — click to expend';
        pip.onclick = () => toggleSlot(cfg.level, i);
        pips.appendChild(pip);
      }
      // Count summary
      const used = Object.keys(state).filter(k => k.startsWith(cfg.level + '-') && state[k]).length;
      const rem = cfg.max - used;
      const summary = document.createElement('span');
      summary.style.cssText = 'font-size:.75rem;color:#5C3A1E;margin-left:.5rem';
      summary.textContent = `${rem}/${cfg.max} remaining`;
      pips.appendChild(summary);
    }

    row.appendChild(lbl);
    row.appendChild(pips);
    container.appendChild(row);
  });
}

function toggleSlot(level, index) {
  const state = loadSlots();
  const key = level + '-' + index;
  state[key] = !state[key];
  saveSlots(state);
  renderSlots();
}

// ── Reset functions ─────────────────────────────────────────
function resetLongRest() {
  if (!confirm('Long rest complete? This will restore ALL spell slots and daily abilities.')) return;
  localStorage.removeItem(SLOTS_KEY);
  localStorage.removeItem(DAILY_KEY);
  renderSlots();
  renderDaily();
}

function arcaneRecovery() {
  const daily = loadDaily();
  if (daily['ar']) { alert('Arcane Recovery already used today.'); return; }

  const state = loadSlots();
  // Can recover up to 2 combined slot levels (half of Wizard level 4 = 2)
  // Find first two expended slots starting from lowest level
  let recovered = 0;
  let messages = [];
  for (const cfg of SLOT_CONFIG) {
    if (cfg.future || cfg.max === 0) continue;
    const slotLevel = parseInt(cfg.level);
    for (let i = 0; i < cfg.max; i++) {
      const key = cfg.level + '-' + i;
      if (state[key] && recovered + slotLevel <= 2) {
        state[key] = false;
        recovered += slotLevel;
        messages.push(cfg.level + '-level slot');
        if (recovered >= 2) break;
      }
    }
    if (recovered >= 2) break;
  }

  if (recovered === 0) {
    alert('No expended slots to recover!');
    return;
  }

  daily['ar'] = true;
  saveSlots(state);
  saveDaily(daily);
  renderSlots();
  renderDaily();
  alert('Arcane Recovery: restored ' + messages.join(' + ') + ' (' + recovered + ' level' + (recovered > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' total).');
}

function resetDaily() {
  localStorage.removeItem(DAILY_KEY);
  renderDaily();
}

// ── Render daily abilities ──────────────────────────────────
function renderDaily() {
  const state = loadDaily();
  const container = document.getElementById('daily-tracker');
  container.innerHTML = '';

  DAILY_ABILITIES.forEach(ability => {
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'daily-item' + (state[ability.id] ? ' used' : '');
    item.onclick = () => toggleDaily(ability.id);

    const check = document.createElement('div');
    check.className = 'daily-check';

    const text = document.createElement('div');
    text.innerHTML = '<b>' + ability.label + '</b><br><small style="color:#8B6914">' + ability.note + '</small>';
    text.style.fontSize = '.82rem';

    item.appendChild(check);
    item.appendChild(text);
    container.appendChild(item);
  });
}

function toggleDaily(id) {
  const state = loadDaily();
  state[id] = !state[id];
  saveDaily(state);
  renderDaily();
}

// ── Init ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  renderSlots();
  renderDaily();
});
</script>
```

## Session Cast Log

Use this to record every spell cast this session for the permanent ledger.

```{=html}
<table class="ledger" id="cast-log">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>#</th>
      <th>Spell Name</th>
      <th>Slot Used</th>
      <th>Target / Area</th>
      <th>Outcome / Notes</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody id="cast-log-body">
    <tr><td style="text-align:center">1</td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td style="text-align:center">2</td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td style="text-align:center">3</td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td style="text-align:center">4</td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td style="text-align:center">5</td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td style="text-align:center">6</td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td style="text-align:center">7</td><td></td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
```
